reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the "Every batch lab-tested" line with a QR code, and anyone can print that. A brand with zero reviews, at $1 a serving for 200 mg, is not getting past me when I can get bisglycinate with hundreds of reviews for less per serving.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR code to the brand's own chosen lab is not the same as third-party certification, and I can't check pill size, stomach effects or whether the dose is real from a new listing.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few hundred verified reviews with the 1-star complaints about stomach upset and pill size looking fine.
